reviews.comment:
Taking him for SCMT 364 . Very knowledgeable, with extra (but useful) info on slides if you choose to apply it.

Grading: 60% exams (with some curves), 40% HW & participation—distribution negotiable on day one. Participation isn't about attendance, but not actively disrupting class

Would recommend—very chill and always willing to help.

I had him for SCMT 364 but it wasn't an option- I think he's still figuring out how he wants to teach/lecture- note slides are a little wordy and sometimes overwhelming, exams not bad & curved, worst exam is dropped. He really cares about helping students in & out of class, good amount of HW to balance out exam weight.

Professor Heinrich was an outstanding professor, probably the best so far at TAMU I've had. He cares so much about his students and he makes himself very available for help. He makes hard material easier to understand & gives extra credit before every test. Stats was hard work, tests were fair, and for it being math he made it enjoyable.
